n x, tanh x, x/(1+x²)) did worse.

The best combination I found was a constant, v, sin(v), v|v|, √x, x, cos(ωt), sin(ωt), and cos·x, cos·v, sin·x, sin·v terms, at NMSE ≈ 2.7e-3. A residual term near sin(2ωt) lowered it to ≈ 2.0e-3, but that is still far from exact, so the structure is still missing.
